# op: # Derived from cx/core/execute.cx: a position k is a register iff the case body reads
# R[a[k]], an immediate iff it reads a[k] without R[...].  Positions beyond arity are
# dropped (SPAN's a[2] is only used by SPAN2, INPUSH's a[2] only by INPUSHXE, etc.).
# OUT uses the macro label CORE_OUT and BYTE uses CORE_BYTE.
# Why this table exists: NN-NF-C needs to place SBLOAD r5,idx / INPUSH r5 / XLEN r4 /
# SPAN2 r4,r4 / INPOP, which occupies two registers that the same query must neither
# read nor write.  That is undecidable from arity alone -- most operands are immediates.
